In detail

North Yorkshire Police recorded 100 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 2.9 per 1,000 residents, the 13th highest rate of York's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (5), drugs (1), vehicle crime (1); the evening/night score by violent crime (10), anti social behaviour (6), public order (3). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Dringhouses & Woodthorpe safe?

Wandroz currently rates Dringhouses & Woodthorpe in York as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York at night. This rating is derived from North Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Dringhouses & Woodthorpe safe at night?

At night, Dringhouses & Woodthorpe is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Dringhouses & Woodthorpe a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Dringhouses & Woodthorpe's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in York) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
